change: Separate frozen authoring caps (200 facts / 32 goals / 64 threads) from runtime history caps (4096 facts / 1024 goals / 1024 threads / 1024 commitments per goal / 4096 total commitments / 8000000 serialized situation characters). Keep at most 32 unfinished or paused goals, frozen active-thread permissions and one unresolved promise per goal. Capacity failure preserves full history.

Version new reader behavior. Preserve exact old reader paths. Optional actor history uses 18000 characters / 6000 estimated tokens, while required closure retains 24000 / 8000. Coordinator limits remain 28000 / 12000. No mandatory reference is silently dropped.

Store complete coordinator selection identities and reasons in durable context-packets bound to the actual assembled text and Manifest. Model text contains compact counts; selected actual material and candidate/actor-delivered reference closure remain. Review packets stay outside player input inspection.

Bound deterministic projection caches to four entries and 4 MiB per cache using full serialized input and isolated cloned values. Changed source, visibility, candidate, policy or budget invalidates the key; large keys bypass caching.

Maintain the existing chat runtime head atomically with each new event. Hash next state outside the transaction, still replay and compare the authoritative prefix inside it, and reject stale or mismatched prepared state. Failure rolls back event and head; idempotence and corrupt-head fallback remain. Other product command paths are unchanged.
